greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oNgcwele. Amen. Kwanga umusa noxolo lukaThixo uYise neNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu makube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siyeza kuwe ngenxa yezono zethu. Khawusihlawulele, Nkosi. Kristu, wena onguMduduzi wababuhlungu, sikhanyisele. Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona intombi encinci, uMariya, enyuka izinyuko zetempile eJerusalema. Wayemncinci, kodwa intliziyo yakhe yayizele kukuzinikela okukhulu. Namhlanje, njengoko sikhumbula ukwethulwa kukaMariya etempileni, sikhunjuzwa ngendlela ubomi obungaba ngayo sisipho esinikelwe kuThixo. UBen wethu, uBenjamin Vo, naye wayenjalo. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, owayebona ihlabathi njengendawo apho angakwazi ukudala, ukwakha, nokunika. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukucwangcisa i-'con chim airlines' yakhe. Yayiyiphupha elincinci, kodwa yayithwele ukukhanya kweminyaka yakhe elishumi elinesihlanu. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, owayekwazi ukufunda izinto ezinzima ze-IT kunye ne-cloud infrastructure ngendlela emangalisayo, kodwa ngaphezu koko, wayenentliziyo eyayihlala ifuna ukunceda abanye.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane usixelela ngamangqina amabini, imithi yeminquma emibini kunye nezikhuni ezibini ezimi phambi kweNkosi yomhlaba. 'Nangona abantu bazama ukubathintela, umoya wobomi obuvela kuThixo wangena kubo,' utsho uYohane. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Umoya wobomi. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa ucinga ngoBen, ngaba awuziva ukuba loo moya wobomi awuphelanga? UBen, nangona engasekho emzimbeni, usaphila kuthando lukaThixo. Ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngovuko. Uthi, 'UThixo akanguye uThixo wabafileyo, ungokaThixo wabaphilayo, kuba kuye bonke baphila.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Kuye bonke baphila. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kodwa nceda, mamela kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo evulekileyo ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. UBen wayengumntwana wokukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayethanda ukuhamba nehlabathi, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Xa uBen wayephila, wayephila ngokukhanya. Kwaye nangoku, nangona engasekho emzimbeni, ukukhanya kwakhe kusaqhubeka.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen. 

Kufuneka sikhumbule ukuba uBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhleka. Nikhumbula xa wayesitya i-Pad Thai enesiqholo eBangkok? Wayekhala iinyembezi ngenxa yokuba yayishushu, kodwa wayehleka ngaxeshanye. Wayengumntu owayeyithanda impilo, owayeyithanda imincili. UThixo uyayazi leyo mincili. UThixo uyakwazi ukuhleka kukaBen. UThixo uyakwazi ukuba uBen wayengumfana onjani. Ngoko ke, musani ukulila njengabangenathemba. Khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizibophelele kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Kwanga uThixo angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ngobuso bakhe. Hamba ngokuthula.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasezintlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike amandla, kwaye abaphe ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mina, Yohane, ndeva ilizwi livela ezulwini lisithetha kimi: Nanka amangqina am amabini: Le yimithi yeminquma emibini nezikhuni ezibini ezimi phambi kweNkosi yomhlaba. Ukuba kukho umntu ofuna ukubenzakalisa, umlilo uphuma emilonyeni yabo uze utshabalalise iintshaba zabo. Ngale ndlela, nabani na ofuna ukubenzakalisa uya kubulawa. Banegunya lokuvala isibhakabhaka ukuze kungani mvula ngexesha lokuprofeta kwabo. Banegunya lokujika amanzi abe ligazi nokubetha umhlaba ngazo zonke izibetho nanini na bethanda. Xa begqibile ukungqina kwabo, isilo esiphuma kwalasha siya kubalwela, siboyise, sibabulale. Izidumbu zabo ziya kulala esitratweni esikhulu sesixeko esikhulu, esinamagama angumfuziselo athi “Sodom” ne “Ejiputa,” apho iNkosi yabo yabethelwa khona. Abo bazo zonke izizwe, imilimi, nezizwe baya kukhangela izidumbu zabo iintsuku ezintathu nesiqingatha, kwaye abayi kuvumela izidumbu zabo ukuba zingcwatywe. Abemi bomhlaba baya kuvuya ngabo kwaye baya konwaba, betshintshiselana ngezipho kuba aba baprofi ababini babebathuthumbisa abemi bomhlaba. Kodwa emva kweentsuku ezintathu nesiqingatha, umoya wobomi ovela kuThixo wangena kubo. Xa bema ngeenyawo zabo, uloyiko olukhulu lwehla kwabo bababona. Emva koko beva ilizwi elikhulu livela ezulwini lisithi kubo, “Nyukani nize apha.” Ngoko benyuka baya ezulwini efini njengoko iintshaba zabo zibabukele.

readings.label: IHubo
readings.text: R. Makabongwe uJehova, iDwala lami! Makabongwe uJehova, idwala lam, oqeqesha izandla zam ekulweni, iminwe yam emfazweni. R. Makabongwe uJehova, iDwala lami! Inceba yam nenqaba yam, inqaba yam, nomsindisi wam, ikhaka lam, endithemba kulo, othoba abantu bam phantsi kwam. R. Makabongwe uJehova, iDwala lami! O Thixo, ndiya kukuvumela ingoma entsha; ngenkiniba enemitya elishumi ndiya kuhlabela indumiso yakho, Wena onika okani uloyiso, nokuhlangula uDavide, umkhonzi wakho, ekrele elibi. R. Makabongwe uJehova, iDwala lami!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Abanye abaSadusi, abo baphika ukuba kukho uvuko, beza kuYesu, bambuza besithi, “Mfundisi, uMoses wasibhalela wathi, Ukuba umntu ufela umzalwana wakhe eshiye umfazi engenabantwana, umzalwana wakhe makamthathe umfazi amzalisele umzalwana wakhe inzala. Ngoku kwakukho abazalwana abasixhenxe; owokuqala watshata umfazi waza wafela engenabantwana. Emva koko owesibini nowesithathu bamthatha, kwaye bonke abasixhenxe bafela engenabantwana. Ekugqibeleni umfazi naye wafela. Ngoku eluvukweni uya kuba ngumfazi kabani loo mfazi? Kuba bonke abasixhenxe bamthata.” UYesu wathi kubo, “Abantwana bale minyaka bayatshata; kodwa abo bafanele ukufikelela kwixesha elizayo nakuvuko lwabafileyo abatshati, kwaye abanikwa emtshatweni. Abasenako ukufa, kuba banjengezingelosi; kwaye bangabantwana bakaThixo kuba ngabo abaya kuvuka. Ukuba abafileyo baya kuvuka, uMoses wakwenza kwaziwa kwindinyana emalunga netyholo, xa wabiza ‘iNkosi’ uThixo ka-Abraham, uThixo ka-Isaka, noThixo kaYakobi; kwaye akanguye uThixo wabafileyo, ungokaThixo wabaphilayo, kuba kuye bonke baphila.” Abanye bababhali baphendula bathi, “Mfundisi, uphendule kakuhle.” Kwaye abazange baphinde babe nabuganga bokumbuza nto.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
